content.short: MethLab is a liquidation-free, oracle-less DeFi lending protocol on Mantle offering fixed-rate, fixed-term loan positions without forced liquidations.
content.description: MethLab is a novel DeFi lending protocol built natively on Mantle that eliminates the two most dangerous risks in borrowing: liquidation risk and oracle manipulation. By using fixed-rate, fixed-term loan structures, borrowers know exactly what they owe and exactly when it is due, with no possibility of forced liquidation due to price volatility. The oracle-free design removes any dependence on external price feeds, making the protocol significantly more robust against flash loan attacks and market manipulation compared to traditional lending protocols.
